section.title: Market data & alternative data: sources, ingestion and local storage for the regime-forecast pipeline (Sept 2026, fact-checked)
section.summary: The pipeline (data_provider.py: ccxt OHLCV from Binance/KuCoin/Bybit + yfinance; cache_5m.py Parquet; sentiment.py VADER) covers only price. The cheapest high-value additions are perpetual positioning (funding, OI, long/short ratio, liquidations) from Binance/Bybit/OKX/Hyperliquid public endpoints via ccxt 4.5.84 (free, no key), Deribit DVOL (free, since April 2021), Coin Metrics Community on-chain basics (32 daily metrics, free, CC BY-NC), and macro (FRED, CFTC Socrata, Alternative.me Fear & Greed, all free). Bulk history should come from data.binance.vision (klines, aggTrades, metrics with OI/LSR, bookDepth), public.bybit.com and OKX's historical-data page rather than paginated REST. Paid aggregators only once revenue exists: CoinGlass needs the $299/mo Standard tier for commercial use; CryptoQuant's on-chain endpoints start at Professional (~$109/mo) - its free tier is market-data-only; Glassnode's usable API is ~$999+/mo; Dune, CryptoPanic and CoinDesk Data all dropped free API access in 2026 and X API is pay-per-use ($0.005/read). Storage on the Mac: Parquet + DuckDB 1.5.x (1.4 LTS hits EOL this month; 2.0 lands in October). The two biggest non-data risks are jurisdictional: Telegram has been actively blocked/throttled in Russia since Feb-Apr 2026 (working again only via the April 11 client update or VPN), and Russia's crypto law took effect Sept 1, 2026 - both must shape the bot's channel and payment design before any data vendor choice matters.

recommendations.name: ccxt 4.5.x (REST) + ccxt.pro (WebSocket, same package)
recommendations.what_for: Unified access to Binance USDⓈ-M, Bybit V5, OKX V5, Hyperliquid, Deribit, Kraken. Beyond fetch_ohlcv use fetch_funding_rate_history, fetch_open_interest_history, fetch_long_short_ratio_history (implemented for binance/bitget/bybit/okx), watch_order_book, watch_trades, watch_liquidations. Note: REST fetch_liquidations is only implemented for bitfinex/deribit/gate/htx - for Binance/Bybit/OKX liquidations use the WebSocket watch_liquidations or Coinalyze. PyPI latest 4.5.84, MIT.
recommendations.cost: Free (MIT). Public endpoints need no API key.
recommendations.integration: Extend data_provider.py with `fetch_derivatives(ticker, tf)` that walks the existing _EXCHANGE_CHAIN calling fetch_funding_rate_history / fetch_open_interest_history(symbol, '4h') / fetch_long_short_ratio_history and ASOF-merges onto the OHLCV index. Feed feature_engineering.py new columns (funding_z, oi_change_pct, oi_price_divergence, lsr_top_traders) for hmm_model.py. Keep binanceusdm -> bybit -> okx -> hyperliquid fallback so a geo-block on one venue does not kill the feature. Live streams: a separate asyncio sidecar (refresh_5m.py-style) using ccxt.pro watch_ohlcv_for_symbols / watch_liquidations_for_symbols writing Parquet every N seconds. Pin `ccxt>=4.5,<5`, enableRateLimit=True, and set explicit Hyperliquid weights (candleSnapshot/fundingHistory = 20).

recommendations.name: Binance public futures endpoints (fundingRate, openInterestHist, topLongShort*Ratio, globalLongShortAccountRatio, takerlongshortRatio) + data.binance.vision bulk zips
recommendations.what_for: Canonical perp positioning. REST: /fapi/v1/fundingRate (500 req/5min/IP, full history since 2019 in 1000-row pages); /futures/data/openInterestHist and the ratio endpoints (1000 req/5min/IP) return ONLY the last 30 days. data.binance.vision: daily/monthly zips for spot and um-futures klines (1m..1mo), aggTrades, trades, plus verified um/daily/metrics (OI + LSR 5-min snapshots) and um/daily/bookDepth; .CHECKSUM files. fundingRate / premiumIndexKlines / liquidationSnapshot folders: confirm in the bucket listing before relying on them.
recommendations.cost: Free, no key. Data has no explicit commercial license; internal signal generation is normal practice, redistribution of raw data is not.
recommendations.integration: 1) `backfill_binance_vision.py`: download monthly um/klines/{SYMBOL}/1m and 5m + daily metrics zips -> Parquet partitioned by symbol/month (pyarrow already present) - replaces long REST pagination and gives 1m bars for the 5m cache. 2) Daily launchd job pulling the previous day's zips. 3) Because ratio endpoints keep 30 days, start a 4h-cadence archiver NOW into Parquet. For a Russian-resident owner: api/fapi.binance.com apply geofencing and Binance stopped processing transactions with EU-sanctioned RU platforms in Aug 2026; run the REST collector on a non-RU VPS (Hetzner NL/FI) and prefer data.binance.vision for bulk. Never put a Binance account key on a RU-based machine.

recommendations.name: Bybit V5 + OKX V5 + Hyperliquid public endpoints, plus their free bulk archives (public.bybit.com, okx.com/historical-data)
recommendations.what_for: Redundancy and RU-reachable coverage: Bybit /v5/market/open-interest, /funding/history, /account-ratio (500 rows/page); OKX /api/v5/rubik/stat/contracts/open-interest-history, long-short-ratio, taker-volume (keyless); Hyperliquid /info metaAndAssetCtxs (OI+funding+mark for all perps), fundingHistory, candleSnapshot (1200 weight/min/IP; candleSnapshot and fundingHistory cost 20 each). Bulk: public.bybit.com trades/klines dumps; OKX historical page has tick trades since 2021-09, OHLC since 2023-07, funding since 2022-03, L2 since 2023-03. Russia is not on Bybit's excluded list, but Bybit is tightening RU-specific rules (RUB P2P delisted, extra KYC) and bybit.com is off Russia's mobile-internet whitelist.
recommendations.cost: Free, no key. Hyperliquid S3 archive is requester-pays (~1 GiB/day of fills; a year is a three-figure AWS bill).
recommendations.integration: Add `bybit` and `okx` to _EXCHANGE_CHAIN for every ticker; derivatives fetcher tries binanceusdm -> bybit -> okx -> hyperliquid. Store an `exchange` column so multi_asset.py / multi_tf.py can compute a rough cross-exchange OI. For HYPE and Hyperliquid-native alts use ccxt.hyperliquid().fetch_funding_rate_history / fetch_open_interests with a hard 50 calls/min throttle. Use nssanta/Bybit-Download-OrderBook-Trades-Klines (Parquet output) for Bybit backfill.

recommendations.name: Coinalyze API (free aggregated derivatives)
recommendations.what_for: Free REST for OI history, funding (current + predicted), liquidation history, long/short ratio, OHLCV across ~20 exchanges, 1min..daily; 40 calls/min per key, 429 + Retry-After. Practical free substitute for CoinGlass aggregate liquidations/OI, and the easiest REST source of Binance/Bybit liquidation history (ccxt has no REST liquidations for those venues).
recommendations.cost: Free with registration. No published commercial license - treat as personal/research; single-vendor risk.
recommendations.integration: `coinalyze_client.py` (or PyPI `coinalyze` wrapper) + nightly job archiving per-symbol aggregated liquidations (long_liq_usd, short_liq_usd) and OI into Parquet; liquidation spikes become a feature for regime_labeler.py (capitulation / short-squeeze regimes) and context lines in bot messages. Guard with an env var so the pipeline runs without the key.
recommendations.maturity: Small team, API stable for years

recommendations.name: Deribit public API: DVOL (public/get_volatility_index_data), get_book_summary_by_currency, get_historical_volatility, funding_rate_history
recommendations.what_for: Options-implied 30d vol index for BTC/ETH as candles (history since 2021-04-01), per-instrument mark IV / OI for 25d skew and term structure, realized vol. Public JSON-RPC, no key. Deribit is now part of Coinbase (deal closed Aug 14, 2025); API unchanged.
recommendations.cost: Free.
recommendations.integration: `options_vol.py`: pull DVOL 1h/1D candles into Parquet, compute dvol_pct_rank_1y and dvol_change; hourly 25-delta skew from book_summary at the nearest ~30d expiry. Add dvol_z and skew as HMM observation columns and as a 'vol regime' overlay in Streamlit and bot text. Exact public rate limits were not verifiable here - a 1h cadence is safely within any documented limit. Deep options history: Tardis (paid) or free Deribit CSVs on cryptodatadownload.com.

recommendations.name: Coin Metrics Community API v4 (free on-chain + reference rates)
recommendations.what_for: 32 daily asset metrics without a key at https://community-api.coinmetrics.io/v4/timeseries/asset-metrics (PriceUSD, AdrActCnt, TxCnt, HashRate, SplyCur, CapMrktCurUSD, TxTfrValUSD, reference rates...). Limit 10 requests per 6-second sliding window per IP. License CC BY-NC 4.0 (attribution, non-commercial).

recommendations.integration: `onchain.py` daily job into data/onchain/{asset}.parquet; derive 30d z-scores of active addresses, hashrate trend and an NVT-like ratio (CapMrktCurUSD / TxTfrValUSD) as slow covariates for the daily-TF HMM only (ffill + 1-bar lag on intraday models). Non-commercial license: use only as internal model inputs; never republish the raw series in the bot. This is now the primary free on-chain source, since CryptoQuant's free tier has no on-chain endpoints.

recommendations.name: mempool.space REST/WS (+ blockchain.com charts)
recommendations.what_for: Free, keyless Bitcoin network data: /api/v1/fees/recommended, /api/mempool, /api/v1/mining/hashrate/3m, difficulty, block times. 'Network stress' features and halving/difficulty context.
recommendations.cost: Free, no key; self-hostable OSS.
recommendations.integration: Extend onchain.py with an hourly pull; compute fee_pressure and hashrate_30d_change. Low priority relative to derivatives, but zero cost.

recommendations.name: FRED API (fredapi) + CFTC COT Socrata API + Alternative.me Fear & Greed
recommendations.what_for: Macro covariates: US 2y/10y, DFII10 real rates, M2, CPI (free FRED key); CFTC Commitments of Traders (Legacy/Disaggregated/TFF) via publicreporting.cftc.gov SODA endpoints, weekly, keyless; Fear & Greed daily 0-100 since 2018 via https://api.alternative.me/fng/?limit=0 (values arrive as strings). Gold: FRED's LBMA AM series was discontinued in 2025 but the PM series GOLDPMGBD228NLBM is still listed; Stooq XAUUSD is the simpler proxy.
recommendations.cost: Free.
recommendations.integration: `macro.py` daily job into data/macro.parquet for the daily HMM and a 'macro context' block in bot forecasts. Fear & Greed replaces/augments VADER in sentiment.py as a long-history sentiment series for backtest.py. COT: CME BTC leveraged-funds net positioning as a weekly feature for multi_asset.py.

recommendations.name: DuckDB 1.5.x + Hive-partitioned Parquet as the local time-series store
recommendations.what_for: In-process query engine over the Parquet files you already write (cache_5m/, tv_ground_truth/): read_parquet with hive_partitioning, union_by_name for schema drift, ASOF JOIN for aligning slow series, native arm64 wheel, no server. Version note: 1.4 'Andium' LTS reaches EOL in September 2026; current stable is 1.5.6 (Sept 28, 2026); DuckDB 2.0 is in alpha with release projected late October 2026.
recommendations.cost: Free (MIT).
recommendations.integration: Layout data/{dataset}/symbol=BTCUSDT/tf=5m/year=2026/month=09.parquet. Replace ad-hoc pd.read_parquet in cache_5m.py / data_provider.py with duckdb.sql("SELECT ... FROM read_parquet('data/ohlcv/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning=true) WHERE symbol=? AND ts BETWEEN ...").df(). Use ASOF JOIN on publication timestamp to align funding/OI/DVOL/on-chain to bars (no look-ahead). Write with pyarrow + zstd. Keep prediction_log.py in a small DuckDB/SQLite file so calibration queries are SQL. Pin `duckdb>=1.5,<2`; evaluate 2.0 only after it ships and extensions catch up. Skip TimescaleDB/ClickHouse until >1 TB or multiple consumers.

recommendations.name: QuestDB 10.x (optional, only for raw tick/order-book ingestion)
recommendations.what_for: If you later store raw trades/L2 from WebSockets: ILP/QWP ingestion, SAMPLE BY / ASOF JOIN, native Apple Silicon builds, Parquet export (ALTER TABLE ... convert partition, or native Parquet tables). ClickHouse is the alternative.
recommendations.cost: Free (Apache 2.0); Enterprise/Cloud unnecessary.
recommendations.integration: Not needed for the bar-based HMM/Elliott pipeline. Adopt only when a cryptofeed/ccxt.pro collector writes >10M rows/day; then QuestDB as hot store, daily Parquet partitions exported for DuckDB/backtests.

recommendations.name: cryptofeed 3.x (bmoscon)
recommendations.what_for: Async multi-exchange WebSocket feed handler (~25 exchanges incl. Binance spot/futures, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Deribit, Kraken; TRADES/L2_BOOK/FUNDING/OPEN_INTEREST/LIQUIDATIONS channels). v3.0.0 (Sept 22) and v3.0.1 (Sept 27, 2026). Requires Python 3.13+. section.title: Modeling, regime detection, forecasting & validation stack for market-regime-dashboard (fact-checked 2026-09-30)
section.summary: The current core (GaussianHMM via hmmlearn + Elliott-wave heuristics + Claude-as-judge rescoring) has no supervised learner, no leak-proof cross-validation and no calibrated uncertainty, so nothing produced today can honestly be sold as a 'forecast'. Recommended path: (1) keep HMM as one regime feature but add statsmodels 0.15 MarkovAutoregression and an in-house Bayesian online change-point detector as independent regime signals; (2) make the real forecaster a LightGBM 4.7 / CatBoost 1.2.10 classifier trained on triple-barrier meta-labels over the existing wave/HMM signals, validated with purged/embargoed CombinatorialPurgedCV (purgedcv 0.1.8 or skfolio 1.4.9) and reported with Deflated Sharpe and PBO from purgedcv (skfolio's DSR PR #255 is still unmerged); (3) wrap outputs with conformal prediction (MAPIE 1.5 TimeSeriesRegressor.update / crepes 0.9.1) so the Telegram bot ships calibrated probability bands; (4) log every experiment in MLflow 3.16 and every published forecast into prediction_log.py. Time-series foundation models are baseline-only: two finance papers (arXiv 2511.18578, 2606.27100) show ~50-51% directional accuracy and negative out-of-sample R^2, an independent 5-min BTC test shows Kronos equal to Brownian motion, and TimesFM 3.0 and Moirai 2.0 weights are non-commercial, so only Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and Kronos are even legally usable in a paid product. vectorbt 1.1.1 (Apache+Commons Clause) for research backtests; NautilusTrader v2 only after 2.0.0 final. recommendations.what_for: backtesting.py: pleasant single-asset backtester but AGPL-3.0. pypbo: PBO implementation, also AGPL-3.0. Both viral for a commercial bot service.
recommendations.cost: Free but AGPL-3.0.
recommendations.integration: Do not use in the paid product; vectorbt (fair-code) / purgedcv (MIT) instead.

pitfalls: No published TSFM or GBM has shown reliable directional edge on daily crypto/equity returns: ~50-51% directional accuracy and negative OOS R^2 for zero-shot TSFMs (arXiv 2511.18578, 2606.27100); Kronos equals Brownian motion on 5-min BTC. Never market the bot as 'accurate forecasts' or promise returns; publish calibrated probabilities and the live prediction_log track record.
Licensing of foundation-model weights: TimesFM 3.0 and Moirai 2.0 are non-commercial; only Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and Kronos may be used in a paid product. Pin model versions.
Pretrained-model look-ahead: TSFM training corpora may overlap your backtest period; evaluate zero-shot baselines only after the model's pretraining cutoff.

Label leakage: triple-barrier labels overlap; KFold/TimeSeriesSplit without purging/embargo inflates accuracy. Purge horizon >= vertical-barrier length. Note purgedcv and skfolio use different parameter names (purge_horizon/embargo vs purged_size/embargo_size).
Multiple testing: every vectorbt sweep, optuna trial and MLflow run is a trial; report Deflated Sharpe with the true N. A raw Sharpe of 1.5 after 500 trials is usually noise.
skfolio does NOT yet ship deflated_sharpe_ratio (PR #255 open); use purgedcv or your own implementation. pypbo is AGPL.
hmmlearn is limited-maintenance (0.3.3, Oct 2024). Keep it behind hmm_model.forward_filter so it can be swapped for statsmodels 0.15 MarkovAutoregression or a hand-written forward filter.
Ensure the bot consumes only filtered (causal) regime probabilities; smoothed probabilities and in-sample BIC model selection make backtests look better than live.

Hit rate is not expectancy: Binance VIP0 fees are 0.10% spot / 0.05% futures taker (0.045% with BNB) plus slippage; a 55% hit rate with symmetric barriers can be negative. Always report expectancy and Sharpe after costs.

MAPIE v1 API: partial_fit was replaced by TimeSeriesRegressor.update(); EnbPI requires cv=BlockBootstrap. Conformal coverage assumes exchangeability — under regime shifts use EnbPI/ACI and re-check empirical coverage monthly in prediction_log.compute_stats(); widen or abstain if coverage collapses.

Apple Silicon: official LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost wheels are CPU-only; fine at this data size. Do not spend time on Metal forks (CatBoost PR #3194 open, MacBoost unverified on PyPI) until training time is the bottleneck.
mlfinlab is proprietary (all rights reserved); do not copy its code. Reimplement from the public algorithm or the MIT mlfinpy fork.

Licensing for a paid service: backtesting.py and pypbo are AGPL-3.0; vectorbt OSS is Apache+Commons Clause (usable, not resellable); Freqtrade GPL-3. LightGBM/CatBoost/MAPIE/crepes/skfolio/purgedcv/statsmodels/arch/river/optuna are permissive.
Claude-as-judge (claude_rescore.py) output must pass the same purged-CV/calibration as any feature; log its traces in MLflow 3 so it is auditable.
Data alignment: crypto bars are 24/7, yfinance macro/equity series are not; do not forward-fill equity features into weekend crypto bars without a flag.

Several primary sites (arxiv.org, huggingface.co, readthedocs, statsmodels.org, mlflow.org, vectorbt.pro, freqtrade.io) were blocked from this environment; versions were verified via PyPI/GitHub, paper numbers via search snippets — re-read the two TSFM papers locally before quoting exact figures in marketing.
open_questions: Which horizons/timeframes will the bot sell (4h, 1d)? Barrier widths, purge length, GARCH horizon and BOCD hazard all depend on this.
How many assets? A pooled model across coins (asset id as categorical) usually generalizes better on small data but needs cross-sectional purging.
Are the Mac 'наработки' already producing resolved outcomes in prediction_log? If yes, export that log to MLflow now as the first calibration dataset.
Signals only, or eventually auto-trading? That decides whether NautilusTrader v2 belongs on the roadmap.

Validation budget: honest calibration needs several hundred resolved events per horizon — roughly 3-6 months of live logging at 4h/1d across a handful of assets — before probabilities are trustworthy enough to charge for.

corrections.claim: Healthchecks.io Hobbyist $0 (20 checks, 3 members); Sentry Developer free 5,000 errors + 10,000 transactions/mo, 30-day retention
corrections.fix: healthchecks.io, sentry.io and the cited comparison sites were all blocked from this sandbox. corrections.claim: T-pro-it-2.0 (Qwen3-32B base, Apache-2.0, RU-tuned) on 48–64 GB; Qwen3.5 / Gemma 4 26B-A4B on 24–32 GB
corrections.fix: huggingface.co was blocked and github.com/t-tech/T-pro-it-2.0 is 404 (the model lives on HF only). Prior knowledge: T-pro-it-2.0 was released by T-Bank's t-tech in mid-2025 on Qwen3-32B under Apache-2.0 with a Russian instruction mix — plausible but unconfirmed for Sep 2026; check the HF card and whether a newer T-pro exists. Ollama 0.40-rc notes use `qwen3.8` as the example model and 0.33.x notes mention `gemma4` on MLX, so 'Qwen3.5' is likely one generation stale — check `ollama.com/library` for Qwen3.8 sizes before choosing tiers.

corrections.fix: core.telegram.org, aiogram docs and tgden.com were all blocked. The repo already implements this (bot/regime_bot/handlers/payments.py, access.py checks currency=='XTR', config.py enforces 'автопродление в Stars возможно только на 30 дней'), which matches the Bot API rule that subscription_period must be exactly 2592000 s. The 30% figure is the Apple/Google in-app cut on Stars bought on mobile; Stars bought on web/Fragment avoid it. corrections.fix: No news or Wikipedia source was reachable from the sandbox, and the WebSearch budget was exhausted. Keep this as a *risk* but drop the specific dates/'48 h' claim and the 'full block announced' wording unless you confirm them; the architectural conclusion (host the bot outside RU; you cannot control RU users' access to Telegram) stands regardless.

corrections.fix: tailscale.com and ssdnodes.com were blocked. Port list matches Tailscale's documented Funnel constraints; keep the 'avoid as primary path' recommendation since the outbound HMAC push already removes the need.

corrections.fix: Documented on core.telegram.org/bots/webhooks (unreachable). These ranges have been stable for years; prefer the `secret_token` check (X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token) as the primary guard and treat the IP allowlist as defence-in-depth, because Telegram can add ranges.

corrections.fix: hometechops.com was blocked. Keep as 'test with a real power-pull' advice; the mitigation (auto-login + LaunchAgents + UPS/smart plug) is sound regardless.

corrections.fix: api.py docstring and `read_signed` confirm the scheme and a /healthz-style handler; `verify` lives in bot/regime_bot/signals.py. Confirm the replay window is actually enforced there (grep for the timestamp tolerance) before relying on it.

corrections.claim: arXiv 2511.18578 'Revisiting TSFMs in Finance' finds modest/unstable edge
corrections.fix: arxiv.org blocked from sandbox. Conclusion is consistent with the 2025 literature; verify the ID/title before citing it to users.

missing: TimesFM 3.0 weights are non-commercial: any 'later' plan to use them in a product needs Chronos-2 or TimesFM ≤2.5 instead — this was the biggest factual hole in the section.

The repo is on claude-opus-4-7 and anthropic 0.x (>=0.30.0). Plan an explicit `/claude-api migrate` + `upgrade python` step: SDK 1.x uses httpx2, prefill is removed, forced tool_choice 400s on 5.5 models, Opus 5.5 default effort is medium, and cache minimum drops from 2048 (4.7) to 512 tokens only after migration.
Server-side `fallbacks` is rejected inside the Batches API — the nightly batch rescoring path must handle stop_reason=='refusal' itself (retry on a second model or skip).
Ollama MLX backend reportedly requires ≥32 GB unified memory (falls back to llama.cpp otherwise) — this directly affects the 16–24 GB Mac tiers; verify on the target machine.
Qwen model generation appears stale ('Qwen3.5' vs `qwen3.8` in Ollama 0.40 notes); redo the RAM→model tier table from ollama.com/library and mlx-community at deployment time.

Telegram Stars subscriptions are fixed at 30 days (subscription_period=2592000); the bot config already enforces this — quarterly/annual plans must be one-off Stars invoices with manual expiry (existing reminder/kick scheduler handles it).
Sentry has moved to span-based performance billing; re-check the free plan before writing '10k transactions' into runbooks.
B2 egress policy: free up to 3x stored volume/month since Oct 2023 (not '1 GB/day'); restore tests will be effectively free at this data size.

Keep-alive alternative to the 1h cache TTL: on Opus 5.5 the 1h write is 2x ($8/MTok); for jobs every 5–60 min a `max_tokens:0` re-send on the 5-min TTL can be cheaper (not allowed with structured outputs or in Batches — use 1h TTL there).

Web-search budget in this sandbox was exhausted and most vendor domains (ollama.com, huggingface.co, core.telegram.org, hetzner docs, healthchecks, sentry, backblaze, tailscale, wikipedia, arxiv) were egress-blocked — the owner should re-run the 'unverifiable' checks from the Mac before finalising the plan.

section.title: Local Apple Silicon deployment + LLM layer for @regime_ai_bot (Sep 2026) — fact-checked
section.summary: Architecture stands: the Mac runs the whole pipeline as launchd-supervised processes with an in-process APScheduler 3.11 (4.x is still alpha) engine and pushes HMAC-signed signals outbound to the aiogram bot on a Hetzner CX23 (€5.49/mo since 15 Jun 2026) — bot/regime_bot/api.py already implements that push API, so no inbound ports on the Mac. Local Russian commentary: Ollama 0.35.x stable today, MLX-by-default only in the 0.40 release candidate (Sep 25 2026) and reportedly needing ≥32 GB; mlx-lm 0.31.3 direct if you need batching/LoRA. Claude stays the judge: repo is on claude-opus-4-7 with anthropic 0.x, so budget a migration to claude-opus-5-5/claude-sonnet-5-5 (cache read $0.20/MTok on both, 512-token cache minimum, Batches −50%, results kept 29 days, `fallbacks` not allowed in batches). Big correction: TimesFM 3.0 weights are non-commercial — for a paid product use Chronos-2 (Apache-2.0) or TimesFM 2.5 only, and only as HMM features. Monitoring/backup stack (Healthchecks.io, Sentry, restic 0.19.1 → B2, Uptime Kuma 2.5) is fine but free-tier numbers and the Russia/Telegram blocking timeline could not be verified from this sandbox and must be re-checked; present forecasts as probabilities with a prediction_log.py track record, never as guaranteed returns.

recommendations.name: launchd LaunchAgents + pmset (process supervision on the Mac)
recommendations.what_for: Keep engine.py, tv_bridge.py and Ollama alive 24/7 with restart on crash/reboot; no Docker on the Mac side.
recommendations.cost: Free (macOS)
recommendations.integration: Generalize the repo's com.example.tv_bridge.plist into com.regime.engine / com.regime.tv_bridge in ~/Library/LaunchAgents (ProgramArguments=/path/.venv/bin/python -m engine, KeepAlive={SuccessfulExit:false,Crashed:true}, RunAtLoad, ThrottleInterval=30); secrets from a chmod-600 .env or Keychain, never in the plist. `sudo pmset -a sleep 0 disksleep 0 disablesleep 1 womp 1 powernap 0`; Remote Login + Screen Sharing; auto-login (FileVault off or accept manual unlock); HDMI dummy plug; logs to ~/Library/Logs/regime with newsyslog. Reports that `pmset autorestart` is ignored on Tahoe/Apple Silicon are unverified — do a real power-pull test and back it with a UPS/smart plug.

recommendations.name: APScheduler 3.11.x (in-process) — not Prefect/Dagster, not APScheduler 4
recommendations.what_for: 5m/1h/4h/daily jobs inside one engine process (refresh_5m, harvest_4h_ground_truth, nightly Claude batch, calibration, backups).
recommendations.cost: Free (MIT)
recommendations.integration: Pin `apscheduler>=3.11,<4` (3.11.3, Jun 2026; 4.0 is still 4.0.0a6). One AsyncIOScheduler with CronTrigger jobs, max_instances=1, coalesce=True, misfire_grace_time=300 so a rebooted Mac does not replay stale jobs. Decorator per job: try/except → Sentry capture → Healthchecks /start, success, /fail pings. Keep bot/regime_bot/scheduler.py (reminders) separate from model runs.

recommendations.name: Outbound HMAC push (existing bot/regime_bot/api.py) — no tunnel
recommendations.what_for: Deliver signals/outcome closes from the home Mac to the VPS without inbound ports.
recommendations.cost: Free
recommendations.integration: Keep: POST /api/v1/signals with X-Regime-Timestamp + X-Regime-Signature = hex hmac-sha256(secret, ts+'.'+body) (verify() in signals.py). Add: on-disk sqlite outbox with retries + idempotent ext_id; enforce a ±5-min timestamp window in verify(); Caddy on the VPS for TLS, only 443 open; rotate SIGNAL_API_SECRET via env. If bot→Mac calls are ever needed, join both to a Tailscale tailnet rather than Funnel/Cloudflare Tunnel.

recommendations.name: Hetzner Cloud CX23 (Falkenstein/Helsinki) for the aiogram bot
recommendations.what_for: Host @regime_ai_bot + aiohttp signal API + SQLite, reachable by api.telegram.org, outside RU.
recommendations.cost: €5.49/mo (2 vCPU, 4 GB, 40 GB) since 15 Jun 2026 (was €3.99); snapshots ~€1/mo. Avoid CPX/CCX — those rose 113–175%.
recommendations.integration: Ubuntu 24.04, systemd unit or docker compose (bot + caddy). Webhook mode with setWebhook secret_token → check X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token as the primary guard; optionally allowlist Telegram's published subnets (149.154.160.0/20, 91.108.4.0/22 — re-check core.telegram.org/bots/webhooks) as defence-in-depth, or use long polling for zero inbound except /api/v1. Hetzner firewall: 443 only. Do not host in Russia (api.telegram.org reachability from RU DCs is unreliable). Hetzner's own site is reportedly blocked in RU — manage via VPN/Tailscale.

recommendations.name: Ollama 0.35.x (stable) → 0.40 when MLX-by-default leaves RC
recommendations.what_for: Local RU commentary from a structured signal; news/sentiment batch summaries; cheap first-pass sanity checks before Claude.
recommendations.cost: Free (MIT); hardware only
recommendations.integration: Ollama.app at http://127.0.0.1:11434 (OpenAI-compatible /v1). MLX has been in Ollama since 0.19 (Mar 2026); v0.40.0-rc0 (25 Sep 2026) makes MLX automatic for supported architectures but is a pre-release — stay on 0.35.x until 0.40 is stable. Third-party reports say the MLX runner needs ≥32 GB unified memory and falls back to llama.cpp below that: verify with `ollama ps`. Model tiers must be re-derived at deploy time from ollama.com/library (Ollama's own notes now reference `qwen3.8` and `gemma4`, so 'Qwen3.5' is likely stale): 64 GB → T-pro-it-2.0 (Qwen3-32B base, Apache-2.0, RU-tuned — HF card unverifiable from here) or a 32B Qwen; 24–32 GB → Gemma 4 26B-A4B MoE or a Qwen ~30B-A3B MoE; 16 GB → 8–14B. OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1, OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1; `format: json`, temperature 0.3, fixed RU system prompt forbidding 'гарантия/точно вырастет', always include invalidation level + horizon, ≤600 chars. Benchmark candidates on 30 of your own signals.

recommendations.name: mlx-lm 0.31.3 (direct) as fallback/advanced runtime
recommendations.what_for: Batched generation, LoRA fine-tune on your own signal→RU-commentary pairs, or an OpenAI-compatible `mlx_lm.server` when Ollama lacks a feature.
recommendations.cost: Free (MIT)
recommendations.integration: `pip install mlx-lm`; `mlx_lm.generate --model mlx-community/<model>-4bit`; `mlx_lm.server` for HTTP; later `mlx_lm.lora` on 300–1000 curated pairs from bot history. Skip LM Studio for the server role (GUI-first). Claims like '~4,800 mlx-community models' and '30–60% faster on M5' come from an unreachable blog — unverified.

recommendations.name: Claude API judge — migrate wave_ai.DEFAULT_MODEL from claude-opus-4-7, then caching + Batches + effort
recommendations.what_for: Rescoring Elliott/HMM hypotheses, adjudicating conflicts, final RU polish of published forecasts. Not per-user chat.
recommendations.cost: Opus 5.5 $4/$20 (cache read $0.20, 5m write $5, 1h write $8); Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10 (cache read $0.20, writes $2.50/$4); Haiku 4.5 $1/$5 (cache read $0.10, 4,096-token cache minimum). Batches −50%, stacks with caching. Rough: 200 rescoring calls/day × ~6k cached input + 800 output on Sonnet 5.5 ≈ $2/day, ≈ $1/day batched.
recommendations.integration: 0) Repo today: wave_ai.py DEFAULT_MODEL='claude-opus-4-7', anthropic>=0.30.0 (0.x). Run `/claude-api migrate` to claude-opus-5-5 (or claude-sonnet-5-5 for routine) and `/claude-api upgrade python` (SDK 1.x = httpx2). Breaking: prefill and forced tool_choice any/tool return 400; thinking cannot be disabled (Opus 5.5 default effort is `medium`, Sonnet 5.5 can use thinking:{type:'between_tools'}); same tokenizer as 4.7. 1) Frozen rules+schema block as `system=[{text, cache_control:{type:'ephemeral', ttl:'1h'}}]` ≥512 tokens (2,048 while still on 4.7!), no datetimes/UUIDs before the breakpoint; assert usage.cache_read_input_tokens>0 in tests. 2) Volatile per-symbol data last. 3) `client.messages.parse()` / output_config.format instead of regex; output_config.effort='medium' routine, 'high' for the daily published call. 4) Nightly rescoring via `client.messages.batches.create` (≤100k req / 256 MB; unprocessed requests expire at 24 h; results kept 29 days; key by custom_id; `fallbacks` is rejected in batches, so handle stop_reason=='refusal' yourself). 5) Extend claude_call_log.py with per-call USD accounting and a daily cap that flips to local-LLM-only. 6) Online calls: `betas:['server-side-fallback-2026-07-01']`, `fallbacks:'default'`.

recommendations.name: Chronos-2 (Apache-2.0) as a feature generator — NOT TimesFM 3.0 in production
recommendations.what_for: Zero-shot quantile forecasts as extra features for hmm_model.py/regime_labeler.py and a baseline in backtest.py.
recommendations.cost: Free — Chronos-2 weights Apache-2.0. TimesFM 3.0 weights are `timesfm-non-commercial-license-v1.0` (non-commercial, non-production) — not usable in a paid bot; TimesFM ≤2.5 weights remain Apache-2.0.
recommendations.integration: `pip install chronos-forecasting` (2.3.2, Sep 2026) + torch 2.14 (macOS arm64 wheels with MPS); `device='mps'` is not officially documented by Chronos — set PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1 and compare with CPU (120M params is cheap). If you want TimesFM for research only, `pip install 'timesfm[mlx]'` (3.0.2) is an official MLX backend. Wire into feature_engineering.py (quantile spread, direction prob at 4h/1d) and gate behind backtest.py/monte_carlo.py + prediction_log.py results; literature reports modest, unstable edge on financial returns.

recommendations.name: Healthchecks.io (dead-man's switch) + Uptime Kuma 2.5 on the VPS
recommendations.what_for: Alert when a Mac job stops running, the Mac loses internet, or the bot's /healthz is down.
recommendations.cost: Healthchecks.io free tier (historically 20 checks / 3 members — pricing page unreachable, re-check); Uptime Kuma free/self-hosted
recommendations.integration: One check per APScheduler job (refresh_5m grace 10 min; engine heartbeat 1 min; daily backup; nightly batch) pinged from the job decorator; notify a private Telegram admin chat. Uptime Kuma 2.5.x (stable, non-beta) in docker on the Hetzner box monitoring https://bot.yourdomain/healthz and the Mac's Tailscale IP.

recommendations.name: Sentry (Developer/free plan) in engine + bot — or self-hosted GlitchTip
recommendations.what_for: Exception tracking for ccxt/yfinance failures, Claude API errors, HMM convergence exceptions, aiogram handler/payment errors.
recommendations.cost: Free tier historically 5,000 errors/mo, 1 user; performance quota is now span-based — verify on sentry.io/pricing (unreachable from here)
recommendations.integration: `pip install sentry-sdk`; `sentry_sdk.init(dsn, environment='mac-engine'|'bot', traces_sample_rate=0.05)`; aiogram error handler → capture_exception; tag symbol/timeframe/job.

recommendations.name: restic 0.19.1 → Backblaze B2 (+ Time Machine locally)
recommendations.what_for: Encrypted off-site backups of prediction_log, holistic_store, wave_knowledge, parquet caches, model checkpoints, bot SQLite.
recommendations.cost: B2 ~$6/TB/mo; egress free up to 3x stored volume/month then $0.01/GB (the old '1 GB/day free' rule is outdated; backblaze.com unreachable — confirm)
recommendations.integration: Mac launchd daily `restic -r b2:bucket:mac backup ~/regime/data --exclude cache_5m`, password from Keychain; `restic forget --keep-daily 14 --keep-weekly 8 --prune`; Healthchecks ping. VPS: `sqlite3 bot.db '.backup'` then restic to a separate repo; Hetzner snapshots as second copy. Quarterly restore test.

recommendations.name: OrbStack / Apple `container` 1.5 / Colima (optional, dashboard only)
recommendations.what_for: Only for containerizing the Streamlit dashboard or DB tooling; engine/Ollama stay native for MPS/MLX GPU access.
recommendations.cost: Apple container free, Apache-2.0 (1.0.0 Jun 9 2026, 1.5.0 Sep 29 2026, requires macOS 26); Colima free; OrbStack commercial price unverified (site unreachable)
recommendations.integration: Native venv for engine/Ollama (containers on macOS cannot use the GPU). OrbStack for least-friction compose; Apple container has no compose per its README; Colima if zero cost.

recommendations.name: Telegram Stars + 30-day recurring subscriptions (already in bot/regime_bot)
recommendations.what_for: Native in-bot billing for RU users without card processors.
recommendations.cost: Stars bought on iOS/Android carry the ~30% store cut; web/Fragment purchases do not. Telegram's Stars→TON payout terms unverifiable from here — re-read core.telegram.org/bots/payments-stars
recommendations.integration: Existing handlers/payments.py + access.py (currency=='XTR' check, renewal flag) + config.py (recurring only for 30 days — matches Bot API's fixed subscription_period=2592000). Longer plans = one-off invoices with manual expiry via the existing reminder/kick scheduler. Keep the risk-warning step before the invoice. Do not front the bot with Cloudflare.
recommendations.maturity: GA in Bot API; implemented in repo

recommendations.name: Tailscale Funnel / Cloudflare Tunnel as the primary signal path
recommendations.what_for: Exposing an HTTP endpoint on the home Mac.
recommendations.cost: Free tiers exist
recommendations.integration: Avoid: the push model removes the need; Funnel is limited to 443/8443/10000 on ts.net hostnames (tailscale.com unreachable to re-confirm) and Cloudflare terminates TLS and is throttled in RU. Use a plain Tailscale mesh if two-way access is ever needed.

pitfalls: TimesFM 3.0 weights are non-commercial/non-production — do not ship them in a paid product; Chronos-2 or TimesFM ≤2.5 only.

The repo is still on claude-opus-4-7 with anthropic 0.x: caching minimum is 2,048 tokens there (not 512), and after migrating to 5.5 models prefill/forced tool_choice/thinking:disabled all 400 — audit wave_ai.py, claude_rescore.py and any regex parsing before switching DEFAULT_MODEL.
Batches: `fallbacks` is rejected; unprocessed requests expire at 24 h (results themselves live 29 days) — batch only nightly rescoring/calibration and handle refusal/expired per custom_id.
Ollama 0.40 is a release candidate; MLX-by-default and the reported ≥32 GB MLX requirement affect which Macs get the speedup — pin 0.35.x for production until 0.40 is stable.
Memory contention: 32B 4-bit (~20 GB) + HMM/backtests + Chronos on MPS can exceed 32 GB; OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1, run backtests off-peak, or buy 64 GB.
Prompt caching silently fails below the model's minimum or if anything in the prefix changes — assert usage.cache_read_input_tokens > 0 in tests; 1h TTL writes cost 2x.
Local LLMs hallucinate numbers: pass prices/levels in as JSON, constrain output to commentary, validate against the input schema before sending.

Russia/Telegram: throttling and the risk of a full block are real but none of the dates/claims (Feb 2026 start, 48-h MTProto kills, spring block) could be verified here — plan a fallback channel and never promise SLAs to RU users.
Regulatory/marketing: wording implying guaranteed returns ('гарантированная доходность', 'точный прогноз') creates liability; publish prediction_log.py calibration and a disclaimer instead.
Time-series foundation models show modest, unstable edge on financial returns — features to validate in backtest.py/monte_carlo.py, never a product claim.
Home ISP/CGNAT: outbound push tolerates it, but add the on-disk outbox, Healthchecks heartbeat and time-based signal expiry so stale signals are not published after reconnect.
Stars subscriptions are 30-day only; 30% store cut applies to mobile-bought Stars — price accordingly, point desktop users to web purchase.
Secrets on the Mac: chmod-600 env file or Keychain, never inside ~/Library/LaunchAgents plists.

Several free-tier numbers (Healthchecks, Sentry, B2 egress, OrbStack price) and the Telegram/Russia timeline could not be verified from this sandbox (domains blocked, search budget exhausted) — re-check from the Mac before finalising.
open_questions: Which Mac exactly (chip, unified memory)? Decides the local model tier and whether the Ollama MLX runner (reportedly ≥32 GB) is even used.
DEFAULT_MODEL is claude-opus-4-7 today — do you want the judge on claude-opus-5-5 (quality) or claude-sonnet-5-5 (cost), and what daily USD cap?
Stars only, or also a crypto/manual rail for desktop users to avoid the 30% mobile cut?
Is one-way Mac→VPS push sufficient, or do you need bot→Mac call-backs (on-demand charts)? One-way keeps the Mac closed.
Home internet: static IP or CGNAT, and is there a UPS? Determines Tailscale membership for admin access and power-loss recovery.
Does the plan ever need TimesFM 3.0 specifically? If so it must stay research-only or go through Google Cloud's commercial channel.

createInvoiceLink: subscription_period только 2592000 (30 дней), цена ≤10 000 Stars, provider_token пустой, currency='XTR'

Цифры $0.013/Star, 21 день, 1000 Stars, вывод только в TON через Fragment совпадают в нескольких независимых вторичных источниках 2025–2026 (в т.ч. отмечено «Fragment без комиссии за вывод», при этом «5% на конвертацию» ничем не подтверждено — убрать). Библиотеки Crypto Pay: aiocryptopay поддерживает только Python 3.8–3.12 (последний релиз июль 2025); для Python 3.13+ — cryptobot-python 1.1.1 (июнь 2026) или aiosend.
Bot API 10.x (2026) добавил ephemeral messages (receiver_user_id) и rich messages — можно показывать персональные уведомления об истечении подписки; проверить применимость в приватном канале.
Санкция Telegram за фиат в боте — скрытие бота/мини-аппа для мобильных пользователей (не формальный «бан»), но эффект для платного продукта тот же.

Налогообложение выручки Stars→TON может поменяться в 2026–2027 — закладывать пересмотр.

Трансграничная передача ПДн: Telegram сам — иностранный сервис; в политике ПДн его нужно назвать получателем и подать уведомление о трансграничной передаче (ст. 12 152-ФЗ) — это касается любого бота, не только внешнего хостинга.

section.title: Платный Telegram-бот @regime_ai_bot: платежи, подписки, доступ к каналу, комплаенс (РФ, 2026) — проверенная редакция
section.summary: Внутри Telegram цифровые товары/подписки продаются только за Telegram Stars (currency='XTR'): правило «Payments for digital goods and services must be carried out exclusively in Telegram Stars» подтверждено цитатами из официальной страницы, санкция — бот/мини-апп перестаёт показываться мобильным пользователям. Stars-подписки: createInvoiceLink(subscription_period=2592000 — пока только 30 дней, цена ≤10 000 Stars), successful_payment с is_recurring/subscription_expiration_date, editUserStarSubscription/refundStarPayment/getMyStarBalance — всё подтверждено в aiogram 3.31.0 (26.08.2026, Bot API 10.3). Экономика вывода ($0.013/Star, холд 21 день, минимум 1000 Stars, только TON через Fragment) подтверждена лишь вторичными источниками — первоисточники telegram.org/fragment.com из облака недоступны, номер пункта ToS «6.2.4» не подтверждён. Для RU-карт — Tribute (10%, выплаты 2 раза в месяц в ₽/€, минимальная выплата 3 000 ₽, webhooks с HMAC-SHA256 в заголовке trbt-signature), для крипты — Crypto Pay (подпись Crypto-Pay-Api-Signature = HMAC-SHA256(sha256(token), body), фиатные инвойсы, тестнет). Юридически: 282-ФЗ «О цифровых валютах и цифровых правах» подписан 04.08.2026 и действует с 01.09.2026 (крипта — имущество, переходный период для физлиц год) — его нормы о рекламе и налогах по тексту не проверены; ИИР/39-ФЗ, стандарт НАУФОР, 152-ФЗ (уведомление РКН, отдельное согласие с 01.09.2025), маркировка рекламы и 3% сбор — действующие требования, часть цифр штрафов из облака не проверена. Ничего из этого не заменяет юриста; прогнозы позиционировать как обезличенную аналитику без обещаний доходности.

recommendations.name: Telegram Stars (XTR) — подписки в боте через Bot API 10.x
recommendations.what_for: Основной канал оплаты доступа к прогнозам внутри бота: одноразовый доступ (sendInvoice/createInvoiceLink, currency='XTR', provider_token='' , prices — ровно один элемент) и авто-продлеваемая подписка (createInvoiceLink с subscription_period=2592000 — «Currently, it must always be 2592000 (30 days)», цена ≤10 000 Stars; несколько подписок одного пользователя одновременно допустимы). successful_payment даёт is_recurring/is_first_recurring/subscription_expiration_date; editUserStarSubscription(is_canceled) отменяет/возобновляет продление; refundStarPayment — возврат; getStarTransactions/getMyStarBalance — сверка; paid media до 25 000 Stars (Bot API 10.3).
recommendations.cost: Telegram комиссию со Stars не берёт, но по вторичным источникам 2025–2026: пользователь платит ~$0.02/Star через сторы и ~$0.014 через Fragment/web; разработчик выводит ~$0.013/Star только в TON через Fragment, холд 21 день, минимум 1000 Stars — т.е. ~30–35% потерь от розничной цены в сторах плюс волатильность TON. Первоисточники (telegram.org/tos/bot-developers, fragment.com) из облака недоступны — проверить на десктопе перед расчётом цен. Обязательны /paysupport и возвраты при недоставке.
recommendations.integration: aiogram 3.31.0 (Bot API 10.3): handler PreCheckoutQuery — answer(ok=True) в течение 10 с (иначе платёж падает); handler F.successful_payment: сохранить telegram_payment_charge_id, is_recurring, subscription_expiration_date в subscriptions (Postgres); при продлении Telegram присылает новый successful_payment с is_recurring=True — продлять до subscription_expiration_date; APScheduler раз в час снимает доступ по истечении. Команда отмены → editUserStarSubscription(is_canceled=True). Если задаёте allowed_updates явно — включить pre_checkout_query (по умолчанию он приходит, а chat_member — нет). Тестировать в Test Environment. При рассылках >30 msg/s — allow_paid_broadcast=True (до 1000 msg/s, 0.1 Star за сообщение с баланса бота).
recommendations.maturity: Официальный API; подтверждено по исходникам aiogram 3.31.0 (Bot API 10.3, август 2026)

recommendations.name: Платные invite-ссылки приватного канала (Star subscriptions для каналов)
recommendations.what_for: Если прогнозы публикуются в приватный канал: владелец создаёт ссылку с ежемесячной платой в Stars, Telegram сам списывает и удаляет неплательщиков — без своего биллинга. По вторичным источникам 100% Stars идут владельцу канала; ограничение периода (30 дней) и управление только из клиента — не проверены (core.telegram.org недоступен).
recommendations.cost: Та же Stars-экономика: вывод через Fragment в TON, холд 21 день (по вторичным источникам).
recommendations.integration: Гибрид: бот продаёт подписку в Stars и после successful_payment выдаёт createChatInviteLink(member_limit=1, expire_date=+24h) либо ссылку с creates_join_request=True и approveChatJoinRequest только для is_active. Отзыв: banChatMember → unbanChatMember(only_if_banned=True). Для чисто канального продукта — нативные платные ссылки.
recommendations.maturity: Официальная функция Telegram (с 2024); детали из облака не проверены

recommendations.name: Tribute (@tribute) — подписки с выплатой на карты РФ, webhooks + OpenAPI
recommendations.what_for: Рекуррентные подписки/цифровые продукты с оплатой картами Mir/Visa/Mastercard и Tether, выплаты в ₽/€; оплата идёт в интерфейсе Tribute (отдельный бот/мини-апп), поэтому не нарушает Stars-only внутри вашего бота. Webhooks: new_subscription, renewed_subscription, cancelled_subscription (а также new_donation, recurrent_donation, cancelled_donation, new_digital_product, physical_order_*); envelope name/created_at/sent_at; payload telegram_user_id, user_id, subscription_name, period, price, amount, currency, expires_at, channel_id. Событий expired/refund нет — истечение считать по expires_at. OpenAPI: https://tribute.tg/api/v1/openapi/en (список подписчиков помечен x-internal — вести свой реестр).
recommendations.cost: Комиссия 10%; выплаты 2 раза в месяц на карту в ₽/€, минимальная выплата 3 000 ₽; цифровой контент по ToS от 1 € до 1 000 €; рекуррент — автосписание ежемесячно в дату первого платежа (по независимой выписке с tribute.tg/terms.html, июль 2026; сам сайт из облака недоступен).
recommendations.integration: Кнопка «Оплатить картой» → ссылка на подписку Tribute; эндпоинт /tribute/webhook: проверить заголовок trbt-signature = HMAC-SHA256(API-key, raw body) через hmac.compare_digest (hex; при отладке проверить и base64 — формат в доке не зафиксирован); кнопка «Тест» в кабинете шлёт событие с пустым name — не падать на нём; new_subscription/renewed_subscription → is_active=True, subscription_until=expires_at; cancelled_subscription → доступ до expires_at, затем снять. Хранить telegram_user_id и user_id (trb). Проверить с юристом оферту Tribute на предмет «финансовой аналитики» и на какое лицо (ИП/самозанятый) принимать выплаты.
recommendations.maturity: Активно используется в RU-ботах в 2026 (десятки открытых интеграций), верификация Telegram и объёмы («70k+ авторов») из облака не подтверждены

recommendations.name: Crypto Pay API (@CryptoBot / send.tg) — оплата в USDT/TON
recommendations.what_for: Крипто-оплата для аудитории, которой неудобны Stars/карты: createInvoice с asset (USDT/TON/BTC/ETH/USDC) или в фиате (currency_type='fiat', fiat='RUB'/'USD', accepted_assets, swap_to), expires_in, payload=user_id; webhook invoice_paid; тестнет testnet-pay.crypt.bot (@CryptoTestnetBot). Не in-app платёж Telegram — внешняя ссылка/мини-апп CryptoBot.
recommendations.cost: Merchant-комиссии на странице Fees and Limits (help.send.tg) — из облака недоступна; никаких конкретных ставок подтвердить не удалось — смотреть в кабинете перед запуском. Вывод — сетевые комиссии.
recommendations.integration: Python 3.13+: pip install cryptobot-python (1.1.1, июнь 2026; sync+async на httpx, FastAPI-вебхук с проверкой подписи и защитой от replay) или aiosend; aiocryptopay 0.4.8 (июль 2025) — только Python ≤3.12. Проверка вебхука: key = sha256(api_token).digest(); expected = HMAC-SHA256(key, raw_body).hexdigest(); сравнить с заголовком Crypto-Pay-Api-Signature. Активировать подписку на 30 дней только по webhook со статусом paid; рекуррента нет — напоминание за 3 дня с новым инвойсом. Юридически: приём USDT и его реклама после 282-ФЗ (01.09.2026) — вопрос юристу; не афишировать «оплата криптой» в рекламе.

recommendations.name: aiogram 3.31.0 (Bot API 10.3) + webhook + Redis FSM + Postgres
recommendations.what_for: Каркас бота: aiogram 3.31.0 (26.08.2026, Python 3.10–3.14, MIT), webhook (aiohttp SimpleRequestHandler) за nginx/Caddy с secret_token, RedisStorage для FSM/троттлинга, Postgres (SQLAlchemy async + Alembic) для users/subscriptions/payments, APScheduler для истечений и рассылок, aiogram-i18n 1.5 (март 2026, Fluent) для RU/EN.
recommendations.cost: Open source. VPS 2 vCPU/4 GB (~5–10 $/мес); бот отдельно от ML-пайплайна на Mac — Mac отдаёт прогнозы по внутреннему API/очереди.
recommendations.integration: Структура: routers (start, paywall, subscription, forecasts, support), middlewares (ThrottlingMiddleware на Redis ~1 msg/s на пользователя; SubscriptionMiddleware проверяет is_active), services/payments с единым grant_access(user_id, days) для Stars/Tribute/CryptoPay. set_webhook(url, secret_token, allowed_updates=['message','callback_query','pre_checkout_query','chat_member','chat_join_request',...]) — chat_member по умолчанию не приходит, его надо включать явно. Рассылка: очередь ≤25–30 msg/s глобально, 1 msg/s в чат, обработка TelegramRetryAfter с бэкоффом; при росте — allow_paid_broadcast (0.1 Star/сообщение). Dev на Mac — long polling; prod — webhook.
recommendations.maturity: Активно поддерживается: релизы ежемесячно в 2026, синхронно с Bot API

recommendations.name: Схема управления доступом: ban/unban + одноразовые ссылки + join requests
recommendations.what_for: Надёжный отзыв доступа к приватному каналу при истечении подписки: createChatInviteLink(expire_date, member_limit, creates_join_request), approveChatJoinRequest/declineChatJoinRequest, banChatMember/unbanChatMember (бот — админ с правами invite/ban). Референс: iomyaki/paid-sub-tg-bot (aiogram + SQLite + AsyncIOScheduler: напоминание за <3 дня, ежедневная проверка, удаление из канала) — учебный образец, не production.
recommendations.integration: На successful_payment/webhook: link = create_chat_invite_link(chat_id, member_limit=1, expire_date=+1 день, name=f'u{user_id}'); после chat_member-события о входе — revokeChatInviteLink. При expiry: ban_chat_member → unban_chat_member(only_if_banned=True). Слушать chat_member/chat_join_request (явно в allowed_updates). Bot API не даёт список участников — вести свой реестр по chat_member событиям и сверять раз в сутки с БД. Одна подписка = один telegram user_id.

recommendations.name: Позиционирование как аналитика/образование (39-ФЗ, стандарт НАУФОР) + дисклеймеры
recommendations.what_for: Снижение риска квалификации как ИИР: по ст. 6.1–6.2 39-ФЗ индивидуальные инвестиционные рекомендации дают только инвестсоветники из реестра ЦБ. Утверждения о базовом стандарте НАУФОР (дата 18.05.2024, «дисклеймер больше не спасает») из облака не проверены — уточнить на naufor.ru/cbr.ru на десктопе. Продукт: одинаковый контент для неограниченного круга лиц, в терминах вероятностей режимов (HMM-регимы, волновые сценарии, калибровка из prediction_log.py), без «купи/продай N лотов», без учёта портфеля, без автоследования.
recommendations.cost: Юрист по финансовому праву: ориентировочно 30–100 тыс. ₽ за аудит оферты/дисклеймеров/контента (оценка). Путь инвестсоветника (ИП/ООО + СРО + реестр ЦБ) — долго и дорого; для криптоактивов 39-ФЗ формально не применяется, но с 01.09.2026 действует 282-ФЗ.
recommendations.integration: В /start и перед каждым прогнозом — краткий дисклеймер (полный — в оферте): аналитический/образовательный характер, адресовано неограниченному кругу лиц, не ИИР, не учитывает цели и риск-профиль, прошлые результаты не гарантируют будущих, риск полной потери средств. Показывать калибровку/Brier из prediction_log.py, не «точность 90%». Не использовать «сигнал», «гарантированная прибыль», «доходность X%». Оферта + политика ПДн — в описании бота и /terms.
recommendations.maturity: Действующее регулирование; надзор ЦБ за Telegram-каналами — из облака не проверено

recommendations.name: Маркировка рекламы (38-ФЗ, ОРД/erid) для промо-видео и посевов
recommendations.what_for: Платное продвижение бота (посевы, блогеры, таргет, ролики) — реклама: договор, регистрация креатива в ОРД (Яндекс ОРД, ОРД VK, МедиаСкаут и др.), erid + пометка «Реклама» и рекламодатель, отчётность в ЕРИР; с 01.04.2025 — сбор 3% от квартального дохода за распространение интернет-рекламы (подтверждено). Публикации о своём продукте в своём канале/боте — самопродвижение без erid. Для финансовой рекламы (ст. 28 38-ФЗ): нельзя обещать доходность, указывать риски — точные редакции (ч. 3.2, 01.03.2025), запрет рекламы в Instagram/Facebook с 01.09.2025 и размеры штрафов из облака не проверены.
recommendations.cost: ОРД: от 0 ₽ для малых объёмов; штрафы ст. 14.3 КоАП (цифры 200–500 тыс. ₽ для юрлиц — проверить на десктопе); 3% сбор с рекламных доходов платит распространитель/посредник.
recommendations.integration: Чек-лист на каждое промо-видео: (1) «Реклама. ИП …, ИНН…, erid: …» первым кадром/в описании; (2) дисклеймер о рисках в кадре; (3) никаких цифр доходности; (4) хранить договор и акт; (5) не упоминать оплату в USDT/крипте. Органика в своём канале — без erid, но требования ст. 28 о достоверности применимы.

recommendations.name: 152-ФЗ: уведомление РКН, отдельное согласие, локализация, трансграничная передача
recommendations.what_for: Telegram user_id, username, история платежей — ПДн; владелец бота — оператор. Подтверждено вторичными источниками: с 30.05.2025 — повышенные штрафы (до 300 тыс. ₽ за неподачу уведомления, до 6 млн ₽ за нарушения локализации/трансграничной передачи, оборотные до 3% выручки за повторную утечку; уведомление РКН об утечке — 24/72 ч); с 01.09.2025 согласие — отдельный документ. Telegram — иностранный сервис: назвать его получателем в политике и подать уведомление о трансграничной передаче (ст. 12) до начала.
recommendations.cost: Юрист/шаблон 10–30 тыс. ₽ (оценка); хостинг в РФ ~500–2000 ₽/мес; уведомление РКН бесплатно (Госуслуги).
recommendations.integration: В /start — отдельная кнопка согласия на ПДн (сохранять user_id, timestamp, версию документа). Минимизация: не запрашивать телефон/email без нужды; БД в РФ; логи платежей — только charge_id. В политике указать Telegram, Tribute, CryptoBot как самостоятельных операторов/получателей. /delete_me. ML-пайплайн вне РФ — только анонимные события.

recommendations.name: Telegram Payments providers (ЮKassa, CloudPayments, Robokassa) внутри бота
recommendations.what_for: Только для физических товаров/офлайн-услуг. Для цифровых подписок внутри бота/мини-аппа — нельзя: «Payments for digital goods and services must be carried out exclusively in Telegram Stars»; при попытке продавать цифровое за фиат Telegram перестаёт показывать бота/мини-апп мобильным пользователям (цитаты официальной страницы подтверждены по независимым копиям).
recommendations.cost: ЮKassa ~2.8% + ~1% за чек (54-ФЗ, по вторичным данным) — но для цифровой подписки в боте неприменимо.
recommendations.integration: Не подключать provider_token для подписки на прогнозы. Карта РФ — только снаружи (сайт с ЮKassa + ККТ/чеки по 54-ФЗ, или Tribute), бот принимает webhook и выдаёт доступ; ссылки на внешнюю оплату внутри бота — осторожно (Telegram трактует обход как нарушение).

recommendations.name: Анти-фрод и защита от злоупотреблений
recommendations.what_for: Шеринг доступа, перепродажа прогнозов, флуд, споры по возвратам Stars (тезис о refund-скаме через сторы из облака не подтверждён — считать практическим риском).
recommendations.cost: 0–низкая
recommendations.integration: (1) Один telegram_id = одна подписка; (2) «водяные знаки» в прогнозах (уникальные вариации формулировок/округления per user); (3) rate-limit на запросы прогнозов (Redis); (4) логировать telegram_payment_charge_id и сверять getStarTransactions/getMyStarBalance при спорах; (5) refundStarPayment только при недоставке, политика возвратов — в оферте и /paysupport; (6) Crypto Pay/Tribute — активировать только по webhook с проверенной подписью, идемпотентность по id платежа; (7) чёрный список user_id; (8) мониторинг 429 и алерты.

recommendations.name: Налоги и юрлицо для приёма выручки (ИП на УСН 6% vs самозанятый) с учётом 282-ФЗ
recommendations.what_for: Stars выводятся только в TON — это цифровая валюта; с 01.09.2026 действует 282-ФЗ (подписан 04.08.2026, вместе с 283-ФЗ): крипта признана имуществом, регулируется инфраструктура (посредники, лимиты, отчётность), переходный период для физлиц год, ЦБ выпускает подзаконные акты (сентябрь 2026). Тезисы «НПД не применяется к продаже крипты» и «НДФЛ 13–15% с 2025» из облака не подтверждены — проверять у налогового юриста. Tribute платит в рублях/евро на карту — подходит под ИП/самозанятость (с оговоркой на оферту Tribute).
recommendations.cost: ИП УСН 6% + взносы ~50 тыс. ₽/год; бухгалтер 3–5 тыс. ₽/мес; консультация налогового юриста по TON/282-ФЗ.
recommendations.integration: Регистрировать ИП (ОКВЭД 63.11/62.01/58.29), оферту и Tribute/ЮKassa на ИП; продажу TON вести через легальный обмен с документами; вести реестр Stars-транзакций (getStarTransactions) и выплат Tribute для учёта. Пересмотреть схему после выхода подзаконных актов ЦБ/Минфина к 282-ФЗ (осень 2026).

pitfalls: Цифровые подписки в боте/мини-аппе только за Stars (XTR): «Payments for digital goods and services must be carried out exclusively in Telegram Stars»; за фиат/провайдеров бот скрывается для мобильных пользователей. Фиат/крипта — только внешние сервисы (Tribute, CryptoBot, сайт).

Stars-экономика (по вторичным источникам, первоисточники недоступны из облака): пользователь ~$0.02/Star в сторах, разработчик ~$0.013/Star в TON через Fragment, холд 21 день, минимум 1000 Stars; ссылка на «п. 6.2.4 ToS» и «5% комиссия Fragment» не подтверждены. Закладывать ~35% потерь; subscription_period только 30 дней; цена подписки ≤10 000 Stars.
PreCheckoutQuery — ответ в течение 10 секунд. Если allowed_updates задаётся явно, включить pre_checkout_query; chat_member/chat_join_request не приходят по умолчанию — включать явно.
Отзыв доступа к каналу: banChatMember + unbanChatMember(only_if_banned=True) и revokeChatInviteLink; Bot API не даёт список участников — свой реестр по chat_member.
Рассылка: >30 msg/s глобально или >1/s в чат → 429/retry_after; очередь + бэкофф; при масштабе allow_paid_broadcast=True (0.1 Star/сообщение, до 1000 msg/s, списывается с баланса бота).

Tribute: нет событий expired/refund и публичного списка подписчиков — истечение считать по expires_at; проверять trbt-signature (HMAC-SHA256 сырого тела с API-ключом); тестовое событие из кабинета приходит с пустым name; минимальная выплата 3 000 ₽.

Crypto Pay: aiocryptopay не поддерживает Python 3.13+ (последний релиз июль 2025) — брать cryptobot-python 1.1.1 (2026) или aiosend; активировать доступ только по webhook с проверенной подписью Crypto-Pay-Api-Signature; merchant-комиссии не подтверждены — смотреть в кабинете.

Юридический риск №1: персонализированные «покупай/продавай» = ИИР (39-ФЗ) — только инвестсоветники из реестра ЦБ; формат — обезличенная аналитика режимов для неограниченного круга лиц, без автоследования. Содержание стандарта НАУФОР и практика ЦБ по Telegram-каналам из облака не проверены — юрист.

282-ФЗ «О цифровых валютах и цифровых правах» (04.08.2026) действует с 01.09.2026: крипта — имущество, переходный период для физлиц год, подзаконные акты ЦБ выходят осенью 2026. Нормы о рекламе крипты и предупреждениях о рисках по тексту не проверены — не строить на них продуктовые решения без юриста.

Реклама: erid/ОРД/ЕРИР обязательны для платных размещений; с 01.04.2025 — 3% сбор с доходов от интернет-рекламы; запрет обещаний доходности; размеры штрафов по ст. 14.3 КоАП и запрет Instagram/Facebook с 01.09.2025 — проверить на десктопе.

152-ФЗ: уведомление РКН до начала обработки (штраф до 300 тыс. ₽ с 30.05.2025), согласие — отдельный документ с 01.09.2025, локализация в РФ, уведомление о трансграничной передаче (Telegram — иностранный сервис), оборотные штрафы за повторные утечки. Не тащить ПДн на Mac за рубежом/в зарубежное облако.

Возвраты: Telegram требует /paysupport и возврат Stars при недоставке (refundStarPayment); политику возвратов прописать в оферте. Тезис о чарджбэках через сторы не подтверждён — считать практическим риском.

Налоги: Stars→TON — цифровая валюта; применимость НПД и ставки НДФЛ из облака не подтверждены; после 282-ФЗ режим может измениться — налоговый юрист до первой продажи TON. Tribute платит рублями/евро — совместим с ИП/самозанятым.
Никаких обещаний доходности ни в боте, ни в рекламе; показывать калибровку/Brier из prediction_log.py.

Ограничения проверки: core.telegram.org, telegram.org, fragment.com, tribute.tg, wiki.tribute.tg, help.send.tg, consultant.ru, cbr.ru, naufor.ru, rkn.gov.ru, nalog.gov.ru, garant.ru, habr/vc/rbc недоступны из облака (egress-прокси), WebSearch исчерпан. Telegram-часть проверена по исходникам aiogram 3.31.0 (генерируются из официального Bot API) и PyPI; Tribute/Crypto Pay — по зеркалам документации и открытым интеграциям 2026; РФ-право — по вторичным материалам 2025–2026. Перед запуском на десктопе перепроверить: Bot API §createInvoiceLink/§refundStarPayment, telegram.org/tos/bot-developers (раздел про Stars), fragment.com (курс/холд), wiki.tribute.tg (комиссия, выплаты, webhooks), help.send.tg «Fees and limits», текст 282-ФЗ, базовый стандарт НАУФОР.
open_questions: Актуальные merchant-комиссии Crypto Pay (help.send.tg/…/9717243-fees-and-limits) — недоступно из облака.
Точный текст раздела Bot Developer ToS о выплатах за Stars (номер пункта «6.2.4» не подтверждён), текущий курс и комиссии Fragment на дату запуска.
Оферта Tribute: разрешена ли «аналитика финансовых рынков/крипты», требования к ИП, страны выплат; формат подписи trbt-signature (hex/base64) проверить на тестовом событии.
Что именно в 282-ФЗ касается рекламы крипты, приёма USDT за услуги и налогообложения выручки Stars→TON — текст закона и подзаконные акты ЦБ/Минфина (осень 2026).
Актуальная редакция базового стандарта НАУФОР и позиция ЦБ по платной крипто-аналитике — нужен ли статус/лицензия.
Будут ли прогнозы по акциям/фьючерсам МосБиржи (tv_bridge.py, yfinance) — тогда риск ИИР/манипулирования существенно выше.
Где физически БД бота и ML-пайплайн (Mac в РФ? VPS?) — локализация ПДн и трансграничная передача.
Bot API 10.x: можно ли использовать ephemeral/rich messages для персональных уведомлений об истечении подписки в канале — проверить по core.telegram.org/bots/api#ephemeral.
